'''''Wachtor''''' was a [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] in the service of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Behind the scenes==
''Wachtor'' is one of several names in the class-specific lists from which the video games ''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]'' and its expansion [[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption|''Forces of Corruption'']] randomly select names for capital ships. The existence of the name in this list indicates such a ship existed in the Imperial Navy at that time, but no other information is canonically available.
